name: Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorder
definition: Autoimmune astrocytopathy, commonly associated with aquaporin-4 antibodies, characterized by optic neuritis, longitudinally extensive myelitis and other characteristic CNS syndromes.

investigations.principle: MRI brain/spine plus AQP4-IgG testing are central; CSF and additional antibody testing may assist.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Some MS therapies may be ineffective or harmful in NMOSD, so correct classification matters.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata-neurological phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Autoimmune astrocytopathy, commonly associated with aquaporin-4 antibodies, characterized by optic neuritis, longitudinally extensive myelitis and other characteristic CNS syndromes.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
